title: Fibonacci Generator
description: Generate the first N Fibonacci numbers with BigInt precision and the nth term via fast doubling.
howto: Enter how many terms N you want (up to 5000).
Press Generate to list the sequence and the nth term.

faqs.a: Identities F(2k) and F(2k+1) expressed through F(k) compute the nth term in O(log n) steps instead of O(n).
F(100) already has 21 digits — far past float precision. BigInt keeps every term exact.

faqs.q: Where does the golden ratio come in?
faqs.a: The ratio of consecutive Fibonacci numbers converges to φ ≈ 1.6180339887.
